acceptance: default page for legacy data: given getDefaultPages() and an element without pageId, expect one page with id DEFAULT_PAGE_ID named Page 1; getElementPageId returns DEFAULT_PAGE_ID

createPage inserts after the given page: given pages A, B and createPage(pages, A.id), expect getVisiblePages order is A, new, B and the new page has a valid fractional index
renamePage trims and rejects empty: given renamePage with "  Flow  " and with "   ", expect name becomes Flow with version bumped; the empty name returns the same array
movePage reorders: given pages A, B, C and movePage(pages, A.id, 2), expect visible order is B, C, A and only A's record changed

deletePage keeps at least one page: given a single visible page and then two pages, expect deleting the only page returns the same array; with two pages the target becomes isDeleted and getVisiblePages has one entry
adjacent page after delete: given pages A, B, C, expect getAdjacentPageId of B is C and of C is B

restorePageState sanitizes input: given undefined, then pages with duplicates, a bad index and an unknown activePageId, expect undefined yields the default page; duplicates are dropped, indexes are valid, activePageId falls back to the first visible page

reconcilePages keeps higher versions: given local and remote records with conflicting versions and a remote-only page, expect higher version wins, the remote-only page is added, result is ordered by index
orphaned elements move to the first page: given elements with an unknown pageId, expect reassignOrphanedElementsToPage puts them on the first visible page

Scene filters by active page: given a Scene with elements on the default page and on page p2, then setActivePageId("p2"), expect getNonDeletedElements holds only p2 elements, getNonDeletedElementsAllPages holds all, getElementsIncludingDeleted is unchanged, the nonce changes
